title: When the Ledger Burns
author: Freya Halloran
blurb: Mirabel Kavanagh, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
